How we know

Spokane Bicycle Club’s Meetup shows the Monday Riverside State Park Out and Back on Sept 21 and Sept 28, 2026 at 9:00 am (titled ‘NOTE 9:00 A.M START TIME FOR SEPTEMBER’, meet 8:45 at Little Garden Cafe); no October Monday date was posted yet, and the club says rides run mid-March to mid-November with Zwift in winter.

Last seen happening Sep 28, 2026.

Hosted by
Spokane Bicycle ClubClub
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

Helmets required. Sign the club waiver; non-members are welcome to ride. Out and back to Nine Mile on the Centennial Trail, riders may go faster and wait at regroups. RSVP on Meetup.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you’ll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spokane Bicycle Club Monday Riverside State Park Ride group ride

Spokane Bicycle Club Monday Riverside State Park Ride is a road group ride in Spokane, WA. It rolls every Monday at 9:00 am from Little Garden Cafe.

A Monday morning club ride out to Riverside State Park. 26 miles at 12–14 mph. The club posts every ride on its Meetup page, including a Thursday ride from the same cafe.
